title: Prime Access Trailer/Revenant
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - "What fatherless aberration is this? Who brings the wicked gift of an unknown mask this Naberus night? Seething with the Void, mocking me and causality alike!
And what strange cruelty named him, to know and defy his death?
This shadow of ill omen. This grim harbinger. This... Revenant."
